tasks.prompt: 把一台带激光雷达的小车放到迷宫入口，让它开进迷宫里，然后告诉我激光雷达看到了什么：离它最近的墙有多远？

criteria.name: a robot carrying a lidar, in a maze
started outside the maze (at its entrance)
criteria.observed: saved at [-2.00, -3.00], the maze spans x -2.55 to 2.55, y -2.55 to 2.55

criteria.name: read its whole lidar inside the maze, a wall in sight
criteria.observed: 1 observe with the lidar inside, the last at [-2.00, -2.13] with 37 of its 64 rays, 24 hitting

criteria.name: the answer says how far the nearest wall is
criteria.observed: no reading to hold it to; the answer names [0.87, 0.43, 0.43]

failures.error: rover comes from the rover template; parts can only be edited on robots built from parts (add_robot with build=...). To build on a template, mount it as a part: {"name": "arm", "robot": {"template": "arm"}}
robot 'lidar_car': base sensors[1] fov must be below 170.0, got 360; base sensors[1] rays must be at most 64, got 72

tasks.final_message: 小车已从入口向迷宫内行驶约 **0.87 米**，并停下。 激光雷达测得，最近的墙面距离约 **0.43 米（43 厘米）**。这是雷达传感器到墙面的距离；未命中的射线已排除。

tasks.prompt: Build me a small robot out of parts, any design you like, get it moving, and record a short video of it that I can share.

criteria.name: a video >= 1 s in which something moves
criteria.observed: work/pip-original.mp4: 124 frames, 18.9 s, frames change 0.012; work/pip-rover.mp4: 79 frames, 11.5 s, frames change 0.023; work/pip-take2.mp4: 81 frames, 11.4 s, frames change 0.023

tasks.final_message: Meet Pip: a small teal rover built from eight parts in simulation. It drives, turns, and spins while staying upright. [Download the 11-second video]( RUN/tasks/parts_video/work/pip-rover.mp4) — shareable 720p MP4.
